From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-09-04T08:12:00Z
Subject: Visibility Tollgate & Owner Rotation — EMEA / APAC Pipeline

Team —

Quick visibility/tollgate for Q3 closing. Finance asked for a short, deterministic pass across all EMEA / APAC opportunities that are in the 30–90 day close window. This is a lightweight owner-rotation + stage-confirmation run to make the forecast actionable.

Ask (48-hour turnaround):
1) For each deal you own or co-own, update the stage to EXACTLY one of: Commit / At Risk / No-Go. No intermediate language.
2) If Commit, add a one-line commitment note (customer stakeholder, verbal/PO/SOW, and expected signed date).
3) If At Risk, add the primary blocker and next step owner.
4) Upload any outstanding pricing docs / signed SOWs to the HubSpot deal (link below).
5) If you want to rotate ownership (handoff to another AE or overlay CS), mark the new owner in the owner_rotation_checklist.pdf attached and notify me.

Priority targets: DEAL-9832 (Nimbus Systems), DEAL-9901, DEAL-10034 — but run the pass across your whole active list. Finance will use the CSV export for the Friday close.

Attachments: 2028_Q3_pipeline_snapshot.csv (exported by region), owner_rotation_checklist.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9832 | https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/forecast-EMEA-APAC

Notes: keep the commitment notes short (one sentence). This is not a deal review — just clean, auditable status for the finance rollup.

Thanks — appreciate quick turn here.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Manager, EMEA Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — will run a pass today. Quick notes on DEAL-9832 (Nimbus):
- Customer has verbally committed to quarter-end (30 Sep) subject to final SOW. Sara (cc'ed) is expecting a final pricing doc and SOW this week.
- I'll mark stage as Commit if we have the signed SOW or a PO by EOD 2028-09-05; otherwise it moves to At Risk with reason: 'Awaiting legal sign-off on SOW pricing adjustments'.

Action items I am doing:
- Updating the HubSpot record (link above) with the commitment line and expected sign date.
- Uploading the latest pricing attachment (waiting for legal sign-off).
- If legal doesn't clear by tomorrow, I will rotate ownership to Vanessa for post-sign follow-through.

Marcus — can you confirm whether Finance needs signed documents uploaded or is a PO sufficient for a Commit entry? I want to be consistent across EMEA/APAC.

Thanks,
Karthik
